merged.title: tools: add global graph-refined EE catalogue and paired progress
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
Loaded-byte coverage counts every copy in boot and the 27 overlays. Add a global
catalogue and paired structural measurement so repeated placements can be reviewed
under one explicit policy for both the denominator and the exact-C numerator.

The primary policy preserves unowned data targets and field encodings, and
refines relocation templates by all external static control target classes.
Mapped addresses alone cannot distinguish a folded field/index constant, and
call target aliases alone cannot distinguish different callees. Both cases have
regression tests using the actual normalizer. No original-source or semantic
equivalence certification is claimed.

Measured results:

- 109,725 pinned intervals across all 28 programs; 84,841 structural classes.
- Conservative EE partition: 44,879,164 bytes; 106,348 exact-C bytes counted once
  with every grouped placement qualified (0.236965%).
- Unsupported extents and unresolved gaps: 8,672,280 loaded EE bytes, retained
  without collapse. O

merged.title: tools: verify shared boot bindings and remaining duplication
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
The global catalogue lost executable section names while its shared-core
resolver depended on `core.text`. Verify the shared boot code space and retain
the evidence needed to explain why the conservative total remains high.

Changes:

- Preserve executable section identities and check them against the pinned scope.
- Replace name-only and explicit-program shortcuts with per-edge boot bindings.
  The producer replays all 28 reference ELFs, complete caller/target hashes,
  executable file/segment ownership and overlay memory/zero-fill nonoverlap.
- Verify 22,522 static edges to 103 supported boot bodies. Missing or partial
  proof stays unresolved. This is combined-reference ownership, not runtime
  immutability; boot RWX, generic writers, IOP/DMA and patching remain unqualified.
- Publish bounded data/GP and switch-boundary evidence and reproducible methods.
  No original allocations or scoped entry-GP/preservation theorem was found.
  Twenty large uncertain bodies are guarded switches

merged.title: fix: refuse unproved control escapes in local GP certificates
merged.author: llesieur99
merged.untrustedBody:
fix: refuse unproved control escapes in local GP certificates

A rewritten return link can reenter an earlier GP memory access with a different
GP. The old producer and typed consumer accepted a first-pass mapped field
because their CFG treated the indirect transfer as an exit. Exact raw-byte
reconstruction does not prove register lifetime.

Require a closed direct CFG before emitting facts or field eligibility. Refuse
returns, indirect transfers, opaque calls, external direct edges and reachable
ordinary or branch-likely fallthrough escapes. Retain fixed-point joins for
admitted internal backedges; changed GP values become unknown. Do not infer
return-link, callee or kernel preservation from an ABI convention.

Preserve the 28 historical MMIO pilot receipts and raw/proof hashes, explicitly
supersede their GP admission, and record all 28 current producer and historical
consumer refusals before facts. The tool remains conditional on normal
instruction completion and supplies no producti

GP. The old producer and typed consumer accepted a first-pass mapped field
because their CFG treated the indirect transfer as an exit. Exact raw-byte
reconstruction does not prove register lifetime.

returns, indirect transfers, opaque calls, external direct edges and reachable
ordinary or branch-likely fallthrough escapes. Retain fixed-point joins for

return-link, callee or kernel preservation from an ABI convention.
